params.name: objectsArray
params.description: Filled with the (unique) names of form objects found; order is not significant

params.name: variablesArray
params.description: Synchronized with objectsArray: filled with pointers to each object's associated variable/field (Is nil pointer if none; a pointer to the subform's table for subform objects)

params.name: pagesArray
params.description: Synchronized with objectsArray: filled with the form page number of each object

params.name: formPageOption
params.default: all pages including inherited objects, if omitted

sentinelValues.meaning: Form current page -- objects of the current page, including page 0, excluding inherited objects
Form all pages -- objects of all pages, excluding inherited objects
constants can be combined/summed to select multiple scopes at once

params.description: Bitmask selecting which form part(s) to scan for objects

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the names (and optionally associated variable/field pointers and page numbers) of all non-list-box objects present in the current form, optionally restricted to a scope via formPageOption.

constraints: List box parts are never included; use LISTBOX GET OBJECTS or LISTBOX GET ARRAYS to parse list box contents.
If a passed array was not previously declared, the command creates it and sets its size automatically, but explicit declaration is recommended for compiled applications.
Passing the deprecated * flag is equivalent to formPageOption = Form current page + Form inherited (3); prefer formPageOption instead.
